title: Camarones al Ajillo
description: A classic Peruvian dish of garlic shrimp, typically served with rice and vegetables. This recipe is a simplified version, focusing on the seafood.
instructions: Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Transfer shrimp to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add parsley to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve shrimp with parsley sauce and lemon wedges, if desired.
If using aji amarillo pepper sauce, stir into parsley sauce and serve over shrimp.
